ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible ventral surface, creating a high contrast against the low-intensity black pixels at the trailing edge, distal tips, and peduncle insertion area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) field across the central and lateral fluke regions. A continuous low-intensity (black) perimeter band follows the trailing edge. Discrete low-intensity (dark) circular focal nodes are distributed asymmetrically: 5 distinct nodes on the left lobe and approximately 8 nodes on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated vertex angle of 55 degrees; the depth of the notch is approximately 12% of the lobe's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, low-amplitude serrations (pixel-amplitude variations of 3-6 pixels) are mapped along the continuous boundary of the trailing edge, with more pronounced jaggedness observed at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A concave mathematical curve characterizes the sweep from the lateral tips inward toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple localized, low-intensity (black) circular pixel clusters (mottling) scattered across the high-intensity (white) field. High-intensity (white) clusters are also visible on the low-intensity (black) distal tips of both lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, symmetrical pigmentation pattern at the base of the fluke creates a distinctive 'Y' shape at the junction with the peduncle.
